> Adds an opt-in shared/multi-user install so several people on one Linux/UNIX box can drive the same Frappe instances without per-user permission errors.

### New Features

* **Opt-in shared/multi-user cwcli install.**
`cwcli setup shared` provisions a dedicated `cwcli` group, a system state tree under `/var/lib/cwcli` with setgid group-writable directories, and, with `--cred-bridge`, a machine-wide credential bridge behind a group-owned socket.
This lets several people on one Linux/UNIX box drive the same Frappe instances without hitting per-user `Permission denied` errors on the cache or config, and without one user's credential-bridge token leaking to another.
`cwcli setup migrate` consolidates existing per-user `~/.cwcli` homes into the shared tree; it never deletes a source and refuses to overwrite an existing shared project.
The default per-user install is unchanged unless an admin opts in, and `CWCLI_HOME` still overrides shared mode for a single invocation.
See the README's "Shared (multi-user) install" section for setup and the security trade-offs.
